capex_override.ack_reason: The out-of-band flag is mechanical only: the band is computed against the last FILED capex value and Royal Gold has never filed one under any candidate tag (last_filed_value is null), so every value flags out-of-band, including the filing-proven $0. This is not an estimate lacking an anchor — it is a figure established by the filer's own cash-flow statements (see source), and no filed capex value exists in any period to anchor to.
capex_override.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 in EDGAR companyfacts under every candidate tag the engine reads, because Royal Gold buys no property or equipment: it is a royalty/stream company whose investing outflows are acquisitions of stream and royalty interests (a separate, growth-investment line the standardized PPE-capex definition does not deduct — the company's own free-cash-flow definition, OCF minus acquisition of stream and royalty interests, is discussed in analysis.md). The filing's cash-flow statement fully accounts for investing activities for all three years with no PPE purchase line, so PPE capex is $0 as a filing fact, not an estimate. Measured impact is nil: the engine's history already carried capex as assumed-zero, so the override changes no OE figure — it converts a silent zero-fill into a sourced, registered decision.
capex_override.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, filed 2026-02-19, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (in thousands): the investing-activities section lists ONLY Sandstorm & Horizon acquisition, net of cash acquired $(411,342) for 2025 (none in 2024/2023), Acquisition of stream and royalty interests $(1,164,753) / $(102,564) / $(2,678) for 2025/2024/2023, Proceeds from the sale of the Versamet Shares and other securities $158,886 (2025 only), Cash calls for Hod Maden equity method investment $(9,330) (2025 only), Proceeds from Khoemacau debt facility $25,000 (2024 only), Proceeds from the sale of inventory - restricted $7,681 (2025 only), and Other $299 / $(116) / $(151) — net cash used in investing activities $(1,418,559) / $(77,680) / $(2,829). There is no purchases-of-property-and-equipment line anywhere in the statement for any of the three years, and the balance sheet carries no property and equipment asset line (the engine's financials_history.csv ppe_net is blank for every year).

moat_against: No pricing power and no operating control — a price-taker on gold (76% of Q2 2026 revenue); operators set mine plans, throughput and closures

Depletion is real and uncharged in the conservative OE definition — stream/royalty interests waste with production, and replacing them means winning competitive auctions against Franco-Nevada, Wheaton, Triple Flag and Osisko

Growth is bought, dilutively — the Sandstorm/Horizon step-change took diluted shares from 65,781,000 (H1 2025 YTD) to 85,068,765 (H1 2026 YTD), and FY2025 stream acquisitions cost $1,164,753,000 against OCF of $704,846,000

Principal-property and jurisdiction concentration — five material properties (Andacollo, Cortez, Kansanshi, Mount Milligan, Pueblo Viejo) across counterparties and countries Royal Gold does not control
moat_for: Contractual, long-life stream/royalty interests on producing mines — revenue with no mine operating or capital-cost exposure; adjusted EBITDA margin 83% in Q2 2026
Post-Sandstorm/Horizon diversification — 393+ interests, no single asset above 13% of Q2 2026 revenue and only two above 10%
Scale and deal access in a consolidating sector — one of the largest precious-metals royalty companies, able to compete for the large transactions that dominate deal flow
Capital-allocation record — 25 consecutive annual dividend increases (2026 dividend $1.90), $500M of revolver debt repaid in H1 2026 from operating cash flow
moat_justification: The royalty/stream model itself is the moat: contractual interests on producing mines deliver an 83% adjusted EBITDA margin with no exposure to mine operating or capital costs, and the Sandstorm/Horizon acquisitions made the portfolio genuinely diversified (no asset above 13% of Q2 2026 revenue) at a scale that competes for large deals. Capped at moderate (5) because the company owns no pricing power and no operating control — gold was 76% of Q2 2026 revenue, operators decide production, the interests deplete and must be re-bought in competitive auctions against Franco-Nevada/Wheaton/Triple Flag/Osisko, and the latest growth step was bought with a ~29% larger share count rather than earned organically. A 5 gives CAP 8.5 years.
name: Royal Gold, Inc.
one_liner: High-margin precious-metals royalty/stream portfolio, moat 5/10 — on the post-acquisition TTM base of $12.13/share it still does not clear 15% at $233.00: weighted IRR 10.16% (Tier C), weighted IV@15% $137.62; it clears 15% only at ~$138 (~$110 with a margin of safety), and on the pre-deal median base the same scenarios print ~7.6% (Tier D).
